Oligodendrogliomas typically show minimal to no enhancement and lack necrosis. This tumor exhibits marked, thick-rim enhancement and a substantial necrotic core, features that are strongly indicative of a non-codeleted astrocytic lineage tumor. The deep gray matter involvement is also less common in oligodendrogliomas. Therefore, the imaging phenotype strongly suggests a non-codeleted status.
